### Visualising CD226 expression
```{r Visualising_CD226}

if(!dir.exists("output/figures/CD226_Expression")){
  dir.create("output/figures/CD226_Expression", 
             recursive = T)}





head(reference@meta.data)



p1 <- DimPlot(object = reference, 
              reduction = "wnn.umap",
              group.by = "celltype.l3",
              label = TRUE, 
              label.size = 3, 
              repel = TRUE) + NoLegend()

p1
dev.copy(pdf, "output/figures/CD226_Expression/WNN_UMAP_subset_annotation.pdf")
dev.off()


CD226 <- FeaturePlot(reference,
                    "CD226",
                    reduction = "wnn.umap",
                    order = TRUE)

CD226
dev.copy(pdf, "output/figures/CD226_Expression/WNN_UMAP_NKG7_Expression.pdf")
dev.off()

p1 + CD226

dev.copy(pdf, "output/figures/CD226_Expression/WNN_UMAP_subset_annotation_and_CD226_Expression.pdf")
dev.off()


Nebulosa::plot_density(reference, 
                       features = "CD226", 
                       reduction = "wnn.umap")

dev.copy(pdf, "output/figures/CD226_Expression/WNN_UMAP_CD226_Expression_density.pdf")
dev.off()


```

### Correlation analysis - CD4 T cells
```{r correlation_analysis_CD4_cells}

# Set up dataset
DefaultAssay(reference) <- "SCT"
reference # 20,957 genes and 161,764 cells 


# subset dataset for just NK cells
unique(reference@meta.data$celltype.l1)

Idents(reference) <- reference@meta.data$celltype.l1

downsampled.seurat <- subset(reference, 
                             idents = "CD4 T")

length(unique(downsampled.seurat@meta.data$celltype.l3)) # 12 cell type annotations
downsampled.seurat # 41,001 cells in total

# reset idents
Idents(downsampled.seurat) <- downsampled.seurat@meta.data$celltype.l3


normed.data <- as.matrix(downsampled.seurat@assays$SCT@data)



cor.df.CD4 <- sc.correlation(normed.data, 
                           goi = "CD226", 
                           remove.quantile = 0.3,
                           output.tables = "output/tables/Correlation_analysis_CD4_DNAM")



################################
# Heatmap of top correlations
################################
DefaultAssay(downsampled.seurat) <- "SCT"
Idents(downsampled.seurat) <- downsampled.seurat@meta.data$celltype.l3

small.seurat <- subset(downsampled.seurat, 
                       downsample = 100)

small.seurat <- ScaleData(small.seurat)

correlation.heatmaps(small.seurat, 
                     correlation.df = cor.df.CD4, 
                     up.n = 40, # number of up regulated genes to show
                     dn.n = 20, # number of downregulated genes to show
                     goi = "CD226", 
                     output.figures = "output/figures/Correlation_analysis_CD4_DNAM")

```
